content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Also a homebuilder selling single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with in-house title and mortgage services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots and sells them B2B to homebuilders; it does not build or sell homes to buyers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers in Sunbelt markets, with in-house mortgage financing."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services offered to them."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title and property-casualty insurance for many customers; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells life insurance, mortgages and cemetery services; homebuilding is absent and its core is insurance and death care."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title insurance and sells data and software to lenders and agents; it does not build or sell homes."}]}
